name: comp-288
title: Success With Undo Actions
description: A slim success notification. A green circled check precedes a one-line confirmation, followed by two underlined-on-hover text actions and a quiet close cross.
use: An action just succeeded and people should see confirmation plus a quick way to reverse it.
avoid: The links and close are inert, so the undo promise is not connected to anything.
a11y: View and Undo are real buttons that take focus, but nothing is wired to them or to the close cross. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow bordered strip with a soft shadow holds a small green circled tick, a short pale message, then the words View and Undo in matching weight divided by a grey dot, and a small X at the right end.
behaves: Pointing at View or Undo underlines it, and hovering the close cross brightens it. Nothing is wired up, so clicking any of them has no effect.
customise: The message and both action labels are typed into the file; the green tick and the width cap are fixed, and there are no props.
weight: light: A strip with a 16px icon and three small buttons.
demo: The message "Message sent" with View and Undo actions beside it.
issues: View, Undo and the close button have no handlers, so none of them responds to a click.
polishWhy: Compact and well balanced, with restrained hover treatment on the actions.
